content:
Ava (Finance): FYI invoice `INV-2026-042` for Acme Corp is 45 days overdue. Amount $118,450. First dunning sent 10 days ago, second yesterday. ACH on file returned NSF on 2026-02-20. No reply from Acme.

Elena (Account Manager): Do we have any active usage that will be impacted? They're on Dedicated Standard tier.

Miguel (CS): Acme is on our dedicated cluster; no immediate outage risk but they have 2 high-priority jobs scheduled next week. We should avoid disruption if possible.

Ava (Finance): Proposed: offer a 2- or 3-installment payment plan to get cash in. My suggestion: 50% now, 50% in 30 days (no fee) OR 3x monthly w/ 1% admin fee. We need sign-off from Legal and approval to pause access only after 60 days if no plan.

Priya (Legal): We can accept a payment plan but need a signed payment agreement and an ACH mandate. Recommend sending a final demand with 7-day cure period before escalating to collections. If we accept plan, include clause: accelerated balance if they default + recovery of collections/legal fees.

Elena (Account Manager): Draft message to customer — want me to send? Suggested text below:

```
Hi John — we're worried about INV-2026-042 ($118,450) which is 45 days past due. We can offer a 2-payment plan (50/50, 30 days) pending signed agreement and ACH mandate. Please confirm by EOD Friday or we'll proceed with final demand.
```

Ava (Finance): That's fine. Also please confirm they received previous notices. Add link to invoice and payment portal:

```
Invoice: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-042
Amount: $118,450
Due date: 2026-01-31
Last notice: 2026-03-10 (2nd dunning)
Payment method: ACH ending ••4321 (failed)
```

Collections Bot: Automated reminder scheduled: 3 reminders remaining before vendor escalation. Next reminder in 48h. Escalation path: internal final demand -> collections vendor (Preferred Collections Co.) -> credit hold -> legal review.

Miguel (CS): If they accept plan, flag cluster to remove scheduled jobs that incur extra cost until payment posts. Also set billing alerts.

Ava (Finance): Need approvals: (1) approve 2-payment plan with no fee? (2) approve final demand + 7-day cure before escalation? (3) permission to hand off to Preferred Collections Co. after cure fails?

Priya (Legal): Approve (1) with signed agreement and ACH mandate. Approve (2). (3) Approve handoff if cure fails; Legal to review vendor agreement and notify Support.

Elena (Account Manager): I'll send the draft now and cc you all. I'll ask for ACH mandate form and include the payment portal link. Tagging @Ava (Finance) for invoice reconciliation if they want to dispute usage.

Ava (Finance): Thanks — please send. I'll prepare the payment agreement template and email it to John once he confirms. Update me in this thread with their reply. :thumbsup: 

Elena (Account Manager): Sent the message — John replied: "We're reviewing internally, can we get 60 days? CFO out until end of month." I'll paste thread if they respond formally.

Ava (Finance): A 60-day extension is longer than I'd like but we can offer 30 days with signed agreement. I'll accept 60 days only if they provide a firm installment schedule and corporate guarantee. Putting holds on escalation for now.

Miguel (CS): Noted — I'll hold off on any cluster suspensions. Please update if they give a firm plan.

Priya (Legal): If they ask for 60 days, require corporate guarantee. CC me on the signed docs.

Collections Bot: Reminder: mark thread for vendor escalation in 7 days if no response or partial payment posted.

Ava (Finance): Action items: Elena to obtain written acceptance, ACH mandate; Ava to send payment agreement; Priya to review if 60-day request. We'll reconvene in 3 business days. :calendar: 

Elena (Account Manager): Roger. I'll update here. :wave:
